reports.desc: I received a text claiming to be GMD management about my house going to auction soon.
Ordered online. Package says delivered, but was not. Company will not provide POD. Company said they reshipped, still not delivered. Tracking numbers do not work. Company will not provide carrier.

I paid for and supposedly took an IQ test. I was charged $1.95 through PayPal. Today, August 27, 2027 I received a PayPal notice authorizing $39.95 For Nordica lab. I did not authorize any additional payments to Nordicsl lab. In fact test was incorrect. I do not want to pay Nordica lab any further amount. I paid the initial amount as requested for the supposed results.
I have contacted PayPal to deny amount but now have opened a case. What else do I need to do?
I received a text message from the number posing to be my morgage company. They set up a phone call and had known the amount of my loan and stated they needed to set up morgage protection
I received a text from a Michigan phone number that stated, "Payment Confirmation #. Your donation to Jon Ossoff has been verified. Click here for details: https://e.givact.com/KCpWgNtl0Mk".
I received a small mailer delivered to my current address but using my maiden name. When I opened the mailer, the only thing inside was a clipping of another USPS mailer pouch.

Vossera sold a 'Halloween Bat Plush' on their website with images that clearly advertised it as the Build-A-Bear bat plush. When I received the stuffed animal, it was clearly not the same product it was advertised as. It was much smaller, did not have some of the detail of the B-A-B product, and did not have the B-A-B insignia on the foot. It seems they have taken down the webpage after I filed a complaint about a refund, but I have attached a screenshot where you can still see the images of the bat from their 'Products' section. If you look at the bat plush on the Build-A-Bear website, the pictures are exactly the same.
Seller confirmed receipt date before my order and did not even prepare my dress and was non responsive in emails, text, and repeated phone calls. Deceptive seller.
Keep getting information of delivery coming and/or delivered but nothing and they do not respond to emails.
Hand off email scam to aquire trade secrets.
